scripts.start: concurrently "cd server && npm run dev" "cd client && npm run dev"
scripts.package: npm run build && powershell -Command "Remove-Item -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue publish; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path publish\server,publish\client\dist | Out-Null; Copy-Item server\index.js,server\db.js,server\package.json,server\package-lock.json,server\.env.example publish\server\; Copy-Item -Recurse client\dist\* publish\client\dist\; Copy-Item start-server.bat,install-dependencies.bat,DEPLOYMENT_INSTRUCTIONS.txt publish\ -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Output '[SUCCESS] Package created in ./publish'"
scripts.prod:build: npm run install-all && npm run build
scripts.install-all: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
